entities.summary: Kyle De Van is an American football coach and former guard who is the assistant offensive line coach with the Chicago Bears of the National Football League (NFL). He was previously an assistant coach for the New Orleans Saints. During his playing career, he was signed by the Washington Redskins as an undrafted free agent in 2008. He played college football for the Oregon State Beavers.
